structural_metrics.name: Features
structural_metrics.description: Set of features in the feature model.

structural_metrics.name: Abstract features
structural_metrics.description: Features used to structure the feature model that, however, do not have any impact at implementation level.

structural_metrics.name: Abstract compound features
structural_metrics.description: Abstract and compound features.

structural_metrics.name: Abstract leaf features
structural_metrics.description: Abstract and leaf features.

structural_metrics.name: Concrete features
structural_metrics.description: Features that are mapped to at least one implementation artifact.

structural_metrics.name: Concrete compound features
structural_metrics.description: Concrete and compound features.

structural_metrics.name: Concrete leaf features
structural_metrics.description: Concrete and leaf features.

structural_metrics.name: Root feature
structural_metrics.description: The root of the feature model.

structural_metrics.name: Top features
structural_metrics.description: Features that are first descendants of the root.

structural_metrics.name: Compound features
structural_metrics.description: Features that have subfeatures.

structural_metrics.name: Leaf features
structural_metrics.description: Features that have not subfeatures (aka 'primitive features' or 'terminal features').

structural_metrics.name: Grouped features
structural_metrics.description: Features that occurs in a feature group.

structural_metrics.name: Solitary features
structural_metrics.description: Features that are not grouped in a feature group.

structural_metrics.name: Boolean features
structural_metrics.description: Pure Boolean features (i.e., features with a Boolean type)

structural_metrics.name: Typed features
structural_metrics.description: Non-Boolean features its selection require to provide a value (e.g., a number, a string,...

structural_metrics.name: Numerical features
structural_metrics.description: Features with a Integer or Real type.

structural_metrics.name: Integer features
structural_metrics.description: Features with a Integer type.

structural_metrics.name: Real features
structural_metrics.description: Features with a Real type.

structural_metrics.name: String features
structural_metrics.description: Features with a String type.

structural_metrics.name: Multi-features
structural_metrics.description: Features with cardinalities (aka 'clonable features')

structural_metrics.name: Tree relationships
structural_metrics.description: Number of relationships (edges) of the feature model.

structural_metrics.name: Mandatory features
structural_metrics.description: Features marked as mandatory that need to be selected if its parent is selected.

structural_metrics.name: Optional features
structural_metrics.description: Feature marked as optional.

structural_metrics.name: Feature groups
structural_metrics.description: Features that express a choice over the grouped features in a group.

structural_metrics.name: Alternative groups
structural_metrics.description: Feature groups that require the selection of just one child (i.e., [1..1] cardinality).

structural_metrics.name: Or groups
structural_metrics.description: Feature groups that require the selection of at least one child (i.e., [1..*] cardinality).

structural_metrics.name: Mutex groups
structural_metrics.description: Feature groups that require the selection of zero or just one child (i.e., [0..1] cardinality).

structural_metrics.name: Cardinality groups
structural_metrics.description: Feature groups with arbitraty cardinality [a..b] that require the selection of an minimum and a maximum number of children.

structural_metrics.name: Depth of tree
structural_metrics.description: Number of features of the longest path from the root to the leaf features.

structural_metrics.name: Mean depth of tree
structural_metrics.description: Number of features of the mean path from the root to the leaf features.

structural_metrics.name: Branching factor
structural_metrics.description: Average number of children per non-leaf feature (aka 'Ratio of Variability').

structural_metrics.name: Min children per feature
structural_metrics.description: Minimal number of children per non-leaf feature.

structural_metrics.name: Max children per feature
structural_metrics.description: Maximal number of children per feature.

structural_metrics.name: Avg children per feature
structural_metrics.description: Average number of children per feature.

structural_metrics.name: Cross-tree constraints
structural_metrics.description: Textual cross-tree constraints.

structural_metrics.name: Logical constraints
structural_metrics.description: Constraints with only logical operators.

structural_metrics.name: Single feature constraints
structural_metrics.description: Constraints with a single feature or negated feature.

structural_metrics.name: Simple constraints
structural_metrics.description: Requires and Excludes constraints.

structural_metrics.name: Requires constraints
structural_metrics.description: Constraints modeling that the activation of a feature f1 implies the activation of a feature f2.

structural_metrics.name: Excludes constraints
structural_metrics.description: Constraints modeling that two features are mutually exclusive and cannot be activated together.

structural_metrics.name: Complex constraints
structural_metrics.description: Constraints in arbitrary propositional logic formulae.

structural_metrics.name: Pseudo-complex constraints
structural_metrics.description: Constraints that are convertible to a set of simple constraints.

structural_metrics.name: Strict-complex constraints
structural_metrics.description: Constraints that cannot be converted to a set of simple constraints.

structural_metrics.name: Arithmetic constraints
structural_metrics.description: Constraints with at least one arithmetic operator.

structural_metrics.name: Aggregation constraints
structural_metrics.description: Constraints with at least one aggregation operator.

structural_metrics.name: Features in constraints
structural_metrics.description: Features involved in cross-tree constraints. The ratio to the total number of features is called 'Extra constraint representativeness (ECR)'.

structural_metrics.name: Min features per constraint
structural_metrics.description: The minimal number of features involved per cross-tree constraint.

structural_metrics.name: Max features per constraint
structural_metrics.description: The maximal number of features involved per cross-tree constraint.

structural_metrics.name: Avg features per constraint
structural_metrics.description: The average number of features involved per cross-tree constraint.

structural_metrics.name: Min constraints per feature
structural_metrics.description: The minimal number of constraints per feature.

structural_metrics.name: Max constraints per feature
structural_metrics.description: The maximal number of constraints per feature.

structural_metrics.name: Avg constraints per feature
structural_metrics.description: The average number of constraints per feature.

structural_metrics.name: Attributes
structural_metrics.description: Features attributes in the model (i.e., number of distinct attributes).

structural_metrics.name: Features with attributes
structural_metrics.description: Features that contain some attributes defined in the model.

structural_metrics.name: Min attributes per feature
structural_metrics.description: The minimal number of attributes in a feature.

structural_metrics.name: Max attributes per feature
structural_metrics.description: The maximal number of attributes in a feature.

structural_metrics.name: Avg attributes per feature
structural_metrics.description: Average number of attributes in features.

structural_metrics.name: Avg attributes per feature w. attributes
structural_metrics.description: Average number of attributes in features with attributes.

semantic_metrics.name: Satisfiable (valid)
semantic_metrics.description: A feature model is satisfiable (valid, not void) if it represents at least one configuration.

semantic_metrics.name: Core features
semantic_metrics.description: Features that are part of all the configurations (aka 'common features').

semantic_metrics.name: False-optional features
semantic_metrics.description: Features included in all possible configurations although not being modelled as mandatory. The ratio is based on the total number of features.

semantic_metrics.name: Dead features
semantic_metrics.description: Features that cannot appear in any configuration.

semantic_metrics.name: Variant features
semantic_metrics.description: Features that appear only in some configurations (i.e., features that are neither core nor dead, aka 'real optional features').

semantic_metrics.name: Configurations
semantic_metrics.description: Number of configurations represented by the feature model. This considers Non-Boolean features and multifeatures. If <=, >=, or ~ is shown, the number represents an estimation.

semantic_metrics.name: Boolean configurations
semantic_metrics.description: Number of configurations represented by the feature model considering all features as Boolean features. If <= is shown, the number represents an upper estimation bound.

semantic_metrics.name: Unbounded features
semantic_metrics.description: Features that can take infinite (unbounded) values and lead to infinite configuration spaces. The ratio is based on the total number of features.

semantic_metrics.name: Total variability
semantic_metrics.description: The total variability measures the flexibility of the SPL considering all features.

semantic_metrics.name: Partial variability
semantic_metrics.description: The partial variability measures the flexibility of the SPL considering only variant features.
